name: @aegis-cc/fleet-operations
description: Every deployed customer Aegis instance reports its own status into Command Center: version, installed modules, license state, self-reported health score, failed jobs, pending migrations. Distinct from Desktop-Apps' per-device telemetry -- this is per-organization, platform-level reporting from the customer's own deployed Aegis backend. Staleness is derived by Command Center's own clock, not self-reported. See CUTOVER.md.
